name: mpx/partial-card-image
title: Card (Image)
description: Image/logo card with heading, paragraph, and optional button. Optional edge-to-edge image, centred content, or natural (non-stretching) image size. Background comes from the parent Cards block.

attributes.label: Edge-to-edge image
attributes.help: Bleed the image to the top and sides of the card (no padding around the image). Text and button keep padded spacing below.

attributes.label: Center content
attributes.help: Centre the image, heading, text, and button inside the card.

attributes.label: Natural image size
attributes.help: Keep the image at its own size instead of stretching to the card width. Ideal for icons/logos. Ignored when edge-to-edge image is on.
